help: Preprocesses Bad Apple video frames and calculates market changes across sector star systems.
Plays or controls Bad Apple video playback on the campaign map. Default playback rate is 0.5 frames/sec (2.0s delay).
Initializes the sector for Bad Apple by populating all star systems with markets and setting all markets to Hegemony (or specified faction), excluding exempt systems like Limbo.
Proof of concept: continuously alternates Chicomoztoc's faction between Hegemony and Sindrian Diktat every second.
